fields.acceptance: daemon-picks.txtar with RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES at 1 GiB: rhiza daemon --once starts and resumes nothing and daemon status --json shows reason disk-low; at 20 GiB the same fixture starts its run; --min-free 0 disables the guard; describe-golden.txtar is regenerated
fields.statement: While free space on the repo's filesystem is under the daemon's minimum (10 GiB unless --min-free says otherwise), the daemon starts and resumes no runs and daemon status reports each candidate skipped as disk-low with the free space

fields.acceptance: An inbox testscript with a daemon state recording a disk-low poll shows one item of kind disk-low in rhiza inbox --json, and none once a later poll records enough space
fields.statement: rhiza inbox lists one disk-low item while the daemon's last poll found free space under its minimum, naming the free space, and the inbox app shows it
